Privacy policy

Your data, in plain English.

Last updated May 16, 2026.

TL;DR. Your voice, your photos, your meals belong to you. We use them to make VoCal work. We don't sell them, we don't ad-target on them, and you can delete everything in one tap.

What we collect

  • Meals you log — name, macros, time, source (voice / photo / manual).
  • Microphone audio — captured only while the mic sheet is open. Apple's on-device SFSpeechRecognizer turns it into a transcript. The raw audio is discarded immediately and never uploaded.
  • Voice transcripts — the text returned by on-device speech recognition (e.g. "medium fry from McDonald's"). Sent to our backend only when the on-device + chain canon both miss, so we can resolve macros via the LLM tier.
  • Meal photos — only if you snap one in-app. Stored on-device with the meal record. If you opt in to cloud sync, they mirror to our backend; otherwise they never leave the phone. You can remove them per meal at any time.
  • Body photos — for the body-fat estimate. Processed on-device. If you opt in to cloud backup they are encrypted at rest with a per-user key and kept 90 days max.
  • Apple Health (HealthKit) data — read access to active energy and steps (only if you grant it); write access for dietary energy, protein, carbs, fat, body mass, and body fat percentage (only when you save a meal or body scan). HealthKit data is not used for advertising and is not shared with third parties. It is not transmitted off your device by VoCal — Apple syncs HealthKit between your own devices via iCloud.
  • Sign-in identifiers — depending on which sign-in you choose:
    • Anonymous: a random device-scoped ID. No identifying information.
    • Sign in with Apple: your Apple subject identifier (an opaque string). Your real email only if you choose to share it.
    • Sign in with Google: your Google account email and stable subject ID, used solely to authenticate you across devices. We do not request your contacts, calendar, Drive, or any other Google data.
  • Subscription receipts — VoCal Pro is billed by Apple via the App Store. We receive the StoreKit transaction (product ID, expiry, anonymous transaction ID) so we can unlock features. We never see your payment card.
  • Usage telemetry — counts of feature taps and crash reports, no content.

What we don't collect

  • Your real name, address, or phone number.
  • Contacts, location, or ad identifiers.
  • Your raw microphone audio (transcription is on-device; audio is dropped immediately).
  • Anything from Apple Health unless you grant the permission, and even then only the categories listed above.
  • Your Photos library — the app only reads the single image you pick or capture in the in-app sheet.

Where it lives

On your device by default. Meal records and (if you opt in) photos can be mirrored to a Cloudflare-hosted backend in the United States — structured data in Cloudflare D1, blob storage in Cloudflare R2.

For the AI tier (only invoked when on-device and chain-canon resolution both miss), the normalized text transcript of your meal is sent to our LLM providers (currently Wafer / Z.AI for GLM-5.1 and OpenRouter for GPT-4o-mini as fallback). We also query the USDA FoodData Central API. We send only the text needed to resolve macros — no audio, no identifiers, no Health data.

Your controls

  • Delete a meal: swipe left in the log.
  • Delete a photo: tap the meal, then Photo → Remove.
  • Revoke HealthKit: iOS Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices → VoCal.
  • Revoke Microphone / Speech Recognition: iOS Settings → VoCal.
  • Delete everything: Profile → Privacy → Delete account. All server-side data wiped within 30 days; HealthKit samples written by VoCal can be deleted from the Apple Health app.
  • Export: Profile → Privacy → Export. You get a JSON of your meals + a ZIP of your photos.

Children

VoCal is for 17+. We don't knowingly collect data from younger users.

Changes

If we update this policy, we'll surface a notice in the app. Email privacy@vocal.best with any concerns.
